rows.claim: The test run was done after the shell recovered.
rows.evidence: Two early bash calls failed with EAGAIN (T0B5, T0B7). The later bash call running `python -m pytest -q` (T0B11, result in T0B16) returned exit code 0 with 8 passed, so the shell had recovered by then.

rows.claim: The original test suite was not run before making edits (implicit: the agent did not run tests before editing).
rows.evidence: The only attempts to run pytest before the edits were the two bash calls at T0B4 and T0B6, and both failed with EAGAIN (exit 75, 'The command did not run'). The first pytest run that actually executed came after the edits (T0B16). So the original suite was never run before editing.
